ENGLISH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.

2. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding : Stressed and unstressed words.
   B. Use insults to “practise” : Stressed and unstressed words.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to : Stressed and unstressed words.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for : Stressed and unstressed words.

5. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. went
   C. going
   D. goed

6. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. blue
   C. quickly
   D. run

7. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. No full stops

   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. where is the library
